sdk_string_encoding_reference.scope: Numeric enum mapping only; no claim about native acceptance or malformed-byte handling.

count_logic.protocol_gate: decoded key !=nil; decoded value !=nil; full w0 exactly1

CFUUID_dataflow.condition: decoded UUID object pointer equals returned NSNull null pointer; not a direct nil test

definition_facts.ja: 配列helperはincoming container.countの64bitワードから1を引き、それをNSMutableArrayのcapacityと反復回数に使う。count=1なら反復なし。count=0の減算wrapや型/範囲を局所的に拒否する枝はない。
definition_facts.en: The array helper subtracts 1 from the incoming container.count 64-bit word and uses it for NSMutableArray capacity and iterations. Count 1 skips iteration. No local branch rejects count 0 subtraction wrap or validates type/range.

definition_facts.ja: indexをvariadic stack slot[sp]へ置き、NS.object.%luを生成してcontainerの値をself _decodedObject:へ渡す。decode結果nilならログと全体nil、非nilならaddObject:する。連番keyの存在やcountとの整合は保証しない。
definition_facts.en: Place the index in variadic stack slot [sp], form NS.object.%lu and send the container value to self _decodedObject:. Nil decoded result logs and returns overall nil; nonnil is added. Contiguous-key presence and consistency with count are not guaranteed.

definition_facts.ja: 辞書helperはn=(count-1)の64bitワードをunsigned LSRで1bitずらしたfloor(n/2)をcapacityにする。unsigned n<2なら反復なし、他はmax(paircount,1)回。偶数性/余り/count0 wrapをrejectする局所枝はない。
definition_facts.en: The dictionary helper uses an unsigned logical right shift of the 64-bit word n=count-1 to obtain floor(n/2) capacity. Unsigned n<2 skips iteration; otherwise the loop uses max(paircount,1). No local branch rejects odd remainder, parity or count 0 wrap.

definition_facts.ja: 辞書のNS.key.%luとNS.object.%luは同じindexを各stringWithFormat:前の[sp]へ置く。key/valueをそれぞれ再帰decodeする。Ghidra Cの省略されたformat indexを、存在しないx3引数として補わない。
definition_facts.en: NS.key.%lu and NS.object.%lu use the same index placed at [sp] before each stringWithFormat:. Key and value are recursively decoded separately. The format index omitted by Ghidra C is not reconstructed as a nonexistent explicit x3 argument.

definition_facts.ja: 辞書keyは非nilでNSCopyingへconformsToProtocol:を送られる。value nilなら選択値w8=0、非nilなら比較返値w0を使い、w8が厳密に1のときだけ格納する。bit0/任意nonzero判定ではない。失敗はログと全体nil。
definition_facts.en: The dictionary key must be nonnil and receives conformsToProtocol:NSCopying. A nil value selects w8=0; nonnil selects returned w0. Store only when w8 is exactly 1, not bit 0 or any nonzero. Failure logs and returns overall nil.

definition_facts.ja: 文字列helperはraw NS.bytesを引き、nilならcorrupt NSStringログとnil返値になる。この値へ_decodedObject:を送る枝はなく、native NSData/type validationは未読。
definition_facts.en: The string helper fetches raw NS.bytes; nil logs corrupt NSString and returns nil. It does not send this value to _decodedObject:. Native NSData/type validation was not read.

definition_facts.ja: NS.bytes非nilなら固定NSString classをallocし、その実返objectへinitWithData:encoding:を送る。x2=data、w3=4。現在SDK NSString.hのNSUTF8StringEncoding=4と対応し、Unicode/UTF16 enum10とは区別する。nativeの不正bytes受理は未確認。
definition_facts.en: For nonnil NS.bytes, allocate the fixed NSString class and send initWithData:encoding: to the actual allocated object, with data x2 and encoding 4 in w3. Current SDK NSString.h maps 4 to NSUTF8StringEncoding, distinct from Unicode/UTF16 enum 10. Native malformed-byte acceptance is unverified.

definition_facts.ja: Attributed helperはNSString keyを読み、固定NSAttributedStringを先にallocして保存し、その後archive self _decodedObject:でraw stringを復元する。raw/decoded nilの局所gateはなく、allocは再帰decode前に行われる。
definition_facts.en: The attributed helper reads the NSString key, first allocates/saves fixed NSAttributedString, then recursively decodes the raw string through archive self _decodedObject:. No raw/decoded nil gate exists; allocation precedes recursive decoding.

definition_facts.ja: allocated attributed objectへinitWithString:attributes:を送り、x2=decoded string、x3=___NSDictionary0__structのbind pointerを渡す。属性情報のkeyをdecodeする処理はない。singleton内容/native initializerの受理・副作用は未読。
definition_facts.en: Send initWithString:attributes: to the allocated attributed object, with decoded string x2 and the bound ___NSDictionary0__struct pointer x3. No attribute-information key is decoded. Singleton contents and native initializer acceptance/effects were not read.

definition_facts.ja: Color helperはincoming self/containerを読まず、固定NSColorへclearColorを送り、その返objectを返す。色成分・color space・archive dataの復元処理はこの36Bにない。native clearColor内容は未読。
definition_facts.en: The color helper does not read incoming self/container. It sends clearColor to fixed NSColor and returns that object. These 36 B contain no color-component/space/archive-data reconstruction. Native clearColor contents were not read.

definition_facts.ja: Identityは$classとuuidStringを別々に再帰decodeし、uuid結果x22をNSNull nullの返pointer x23と等値比較する。UUID再生成の条件はpointer equalityであり、uuid結果nilだけを見る枝ではない。native null返値自体は未確認。
definition_facts.en: Identity recursively decodes $class and uuidString separately, then compares UUID result x22 with returned NSNull null pointer x23. UUID regeneration uses pointer equality, not merely a nil UUID-result test. The native null result itself is unverified.

definition_facts.ja: 一致枝はkCFAllocatorDefaultのimport pointerをさらにdereferenceした値をCFUUIDCreateのx0へ渡す。実返UUID x0をx23へ保存し、CFUUIDCreateStringはallocator x0=0、UUID x1=x23で呼ぶ。実返string x0をx24へ保存する。
definition_facts.en: On equality, dereference the imported kCFAllocatorDefault pointer to supply CFUUIDCreate x0. Save the actual returned UUID x0 in x23. Call CFUUIDCreateString with allocator x0=0 and UUID x1=x23, then save its actual returned string x0 in x24.

definition_facts.ja: 生成後は以前のdecoded UUID objectをreleaseし、新string x24をx22へ置き、CFReleaseへ実UUID x23を渡す。allocatorをUUIDとして渡すC表示は採用しない。Create/CreateString nil/error枝は本文にない。
definition_facts.en: After creation, release the previous decoded UUID object, replace x22 with actual new string x24 and pass actual UUID x23 to CFRelease. Reject the C display that misuses the allocator as UUID. No local Create/CreateString nil/error branch exists.

definition_facts.ja: decoded classNameをarchive classForClassName:へ渡し、返Classをobjc_allocし、そのallocated objectへ選択/生成したUUID stringでinitWithString:を送る。Class/UUID有効性、生成ID安定性、init失敗や実受理は確定しない。
definition_facts.en: Pass decoded className to archive classForClassName:, allocate its returned Class and send initWithString: using the selected/generated UUID string to the allocated object. Class/UUID validity, generated-ID stability, initializer failure and actual acceptance remain unestablished.

definition_facts.ja: channel helperは$class、aliasIndex、index、typeをそれぞれ再帰decodeする。decoded classNameはclassForClassName:へ渡し、そのClassをchannel factoryのreceiverにする。固定MAChannelIDをこの本文で直接allocするのではない。
definition_facts.en: The channel helper recursively decodes $class, aliasIndex, index and type separately. Pass decoded className to classForClassName: and use the returned Class as channel-factory receiver. This body does not directly allocate fixed MAChannelID.

definition_facts.ja: type.intValueの下位w25をSXTWでx2へ符号拡張し、index/aliasIndex.unsignedIntValueの下位32bitをw3/w4でゼロ拡張してchannelIDWithType:index:aliasIndex:へ渡す。enum/range/ID契約の局所検証はない。
definition_facts.en: Sign-extend low w25 from type.intValue into x2 with SXTW, and zero-extend low 32 bits of index/aliasIndex.unsignedIntValue through w3/w4 into channelIDWithType:index:aliasIndex:. No local enum/range/ID-contract validation exists.

definition_facts.ja: channel本文424Bにはnil/type/error/範囲の条件分岐がなく、factory返objectをretainして通常release後に返す。factory内部のallocation/副作用やnative数値変換・失敗動作は未読。
definition_facts.en: The 424 B channel body has no nil/type/error/range conditional branch. Retain and return the factory object after normal releases. Factory allocation/effects and native numeric-conversion/failure behavior were not read.

definition_facts.ja: 固定object initWithProperties:はincoming propertiesをretainし、objc_super={incoming self,固定object class}でinitを送る。super nilならcopy/storeを飛ばし、通常終了でpropertiesをreleaseし、実super返値を返す。
definition_facts.en: Fixed-object initWithProperties: retains incoming properties and sends init with objc_super={incoming self,fixed object class}. A nil super result skips copy/store; normal cleanup releases properties and returns the actual super result.

definition_facts.ja: super非nilならincoming propertiesへcopyを送り、その実返objectをself+8の_properties（宣言NSDictionary/8B）へ置き、旧fieldをreleaseする。Class名による追加instantiate、深いcopy/実型/復元同一性の保証はこの本文にない。
definition_facts.en: For nonnil super result, send incoming properties copy, replace _properties at self+8 (declared NSDictionary/8B) with that actual object result, and release the previous field. This body provides no additional class-name instantiation or deep-copy/runtime-type/restoration-identity guarantee.

definition_facts.ja: 8固定本文と最小supportを照合した静的結果。native/dynamic helper/constructor内部、実効dispatch、nil/error/例外の全cleanup、受理schema/typed layout、UUID/ID契約、roundtrip/保存再読込/Undo/製品capabilityは未確認。
definition_facts.en: Static results cover eight fixed bodies and minimal support. Native/dynamic helper/constructor internals, effective dispatch, complete nil/error/exception cleanup, accepted schema/typed layout, UUID/ID contracts, roundtrip/save-reload/Undo and product capabilities remain unverified.

decompiler_pitfalls: stringWithFormat C omits the counter stored in the variadic stack slot; no explicit x3 index is established.
Identity C conflates allocator and CFUUID/CFString outputs. ASM preserves actual UUID x23, creates string x24 and releases UUID x23.
String/Attributed/Identity C obscures objc_alloc returned-object receivers; ASM sends initializers to the actual allocated objects.
Dictionary conformsToProtocol acceptance compares the full 32-bit result to exactly 1, not just nonzero or bit 0.
Count-derived capacities are unchecked 64-bit subtraction/unsigned shift, not proof of valid archive field counts.
limits: Fresh root export/import identity is original-import metadata, not a checksum of database annotations or effective dispatch.
No native Foundation/AppKit/CFUUID or dynamic helper/constructor body expansion. SDK enum mapping does not prove decoding acceptance.
Typed _properties declaration/literal offset do not verify live layout or actual copy/input/output classes.
No accepted archive schema/count/range, protocol normalization, native nil/error/default or full exception ownership proof.
Pointer equality to returned NSNull is distinct from a nil test; generated CFUUID behavior/validity/identity stability remains unverified.
No native mutable-collection/copy/constructor side-effect or failure semantics established.
No live Logic/AppleEvent, UUID/public-ID contract, roundtrip/save/reload/Undo or product capability verification.
